extra.message: User-supplied parameter 'name' is directly interpolated into a template string and then rendered using Jinja2's Template class on line 41. This allows Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI), which can lead to Remote Code Execution (RCE).

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Template Directives Using a Template Engine
CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: The application makes an HTTP request using requests.get() with config.PUBLIC_IP_SERVICE_URL, which is retrieved directly from an environment variable. If this URL is controlled by an untrusted source or modified, it can lead to Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).
A secret token 'SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN' is hardcoded directly in the configuration settings on line 15.
